title: Best Everyday Shoes (2026)
summary: We're still testing and researching this guide. Picks will be added soon.
method: Selected from the reviews on rtings.com, Tom’s Guide, CNET, and Treeline Review. Products were chosen for their mention in at least one source and for covering key everyday use cases such as running, walking, and minimalist wear.
assumptions: Prices are not listed in the sources, so cost comparisons are omitted.
